Mapping Turkey's Artificial Intelligence Landscape

This dashboard provides a comprehensive, data-driven view of Turkey's AI startup ecosystem. The entire database — spanning 1,280 companies, 1,372 investors, and 12 tracked deals — is autonomously built and maintained by an AI-powered multi-agent system. Each company profile is researched, verified, and enriched through a three-pass LLM pipeline that extracts facts from web sources, classifies AI relevance, and audits data quality. No manual data entry — every field is machine-generated and continuously updated.
